_comment: Universal safety blocklist applied at every academic level, from Grade 1 through Master's. These categories cover genuinely harmful, illegal, hateful, sexual, or dangerous content and are never relaxed for adult/college-level academic access. Ordinary academic discussion of history, medicine, law, politics, or social issues is NOT blocked by this list -- only explicit instructions/content in these categories are.
